label: Earth zoom out
blurb: From your face to outer space
prompt: Continuous vertical zoom-out from a close-up of the subject straight up through the rooftops, the town, the region, the clouds, to Earth from orbit; one unbroken shot, photoreal satellite detail at each altitude, smooth exponential speed-up, no cuts.
render_prompt: Continuous vertical zoom-in from high above straight down onto the subject: from the clouds over the region, down over the town and the rooftops, ending on a close-up of the subject's face; one unbroken shot, photoreal aerial detail at each altitude, smooth exponential slow-down as it lands on the face, no cuts.
